title: Bound-slot profile-fit advice
description: Requires an isolated local gateway with the real farmslot-farm project config and a synthetic CLI pr720-test-N slot without simulator resources. Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_PROFILE_FIT_TEST_SLOT. Creates a manual validation run, checks dispatch preview and the actual GRADE decision before PREPARE.

verify-profile-fit.intent: Assert the gateway warns in preview and blocks an incompatible core run at GRADE.
